title: Synthetic assumptions register for the demo governed-data-foundation Move

rows.statement: The governed data foundation is sized against the $5.0M one-time budget planned for the data governance and stewardship foundation program.
rows.why_it_matters: It is the investment the value case has to clear. It is a planning line in the program portfolio, not a funding decision.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, programs and initiatives: Data Governance & Stewardship Foundation, budget_usd [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/09_programs_initiatives.csv]

rows.statement: The program's planning estimate of value is $5.82M; it is not a Finance-approved benefit.
rows.why_it_matters: No benefit can be claimed until Finance agrees a baseline, a counterfactual and a measurement method; the discovery finance plan keeps benefits unquantified until then.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, programs and initiatives: Data Governance & Stewardship Foundation, expected_value_usd [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/09_programs_initiatives.csv]

rows.statement: Benefits start no earlier than 8 months after the program starts (program start November 2026, benefit realization July 2027).
rows.why_it_matters: It sets the first month the value plan may show any benefit, which drives payback and the in-year value claim.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, programs and initiatives: Data Governance & Stewardship Foundation, start_date and benefit_realization_start [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/09_programs_initiatives.csv]

rows.statement: Today's annual data and analytics platform spend of $44.2M is the baseline any platform saving is measured against.
rows.why_it_matters: A consolidation saving cannot exceed the spend it comes out of. The figure is single-source synthetic intake, so Finance must confirm it before a saving is netted against it.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, IT spend and value: Data & Analytics Platform, annual_spend_usd [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/08_spend_value.csv]

rows.statement: About 60 domain reporting marts, ETL jobs, cubes and report sets are each fed separately from the EHR reporting database, with no reconciled source of truth across them.
rows.why_it_matters: The number of marts is the consolidation scope. Each one is a definition that has to be rationalised into the semantic layer or retired.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, data and analytics platform maturity: On-Prem SQL Server Datamart Estate, evidence [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/19_data_analytics_platform_maturity.csv]

confirm.answer: Confirmed against the platform maturity assessment dated 2026-07-31: roughly 60 marts, ETL jobs, cubes and report sets, one per domain. Synthetic and single-source; not client-attested.
confirm.answer_source: Synthetic platform maturity assessment, On-Prem SQL Server Datamart Estate row, assessed 2026-07-31 [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/19_data_analytics_platform_maturity.csv]

rows.statement: About 620 self-published BI workbooks sit on the on-premises BI server, most without an assigned owner or refresh service level.
rows.why_it_matters: Ungoverned workbooks are where uncertified numbers reach executives today. They are the adoption target for certified measures.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, data and analytics platform maturity: Tableau Server (On-Prem Self-Service BI), evidence [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/19_data_analytics_platform_maturity.csv]

confirm.answer: Confirmed against the platform maturity assessment dated 2026-07-31: roughly 620 self-published workbooks, most without an owner or refresh SLA. Synthetic and single-source; not client-attested.
confirm.answer_source: Synthetic platform maturity assessment, Tableau Server (On-Prem Self-Service BI) row, assessed 2026-07-31 [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/19_data_analytics_platform_maturity.csv]

rows.statement: About half of the cataloged data assets (276 of 540) are governed and production grade; the rest are still developing governance or carry documented gaps.
rows.why_it_matters: It sizes the governance backlog. Assets that are not production grade cannot feed a certified measure or an AI feature.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, data assets and integrations: quality_status across 540 assets [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/05_data_assets_integrations.csv]

rows.statement: Six source systems are in scope for the first certified slice: EHR core, claims, enrollment, provider directory, lab results and segmented behavioral health.
rows.why_it_matters: Each source needs an approved purpose, a minimum-necessary field list and an access owner before any sample is copied. Access is not yet granted for any of them.
rows.source: Synthetic discovery evidence, source-system data access register [scripts/moves/fixtures/gdf-discovery-aca-smoke/02_p2_discover/05_source_system_data_access.csv]

rows.statement: Ten data-quality rules gate the first certified datasets, and five of them are blockers that quarantine a batch on failure.
rows.why_it_matters: Blocker rules decide whether a certified measure can publish at all. Their thresholds are not yet validated against real data.
rows.source: Synthetic discovery evidence, data-quality rules register [scripts/moves/fixtures/gdf-discovery-aca-smoke/02_p2_discover/04_data_quality_rules.csv]

rows.statement: The build runs for 12 months, from November 2026 to the end of October 2027.
rows.why_it_matters: The duration sets the delivery cost, the team plan and when the first certified release can land.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, programs and initiatives: Data Governance & Stewardship Foundation, start_date and end_date [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/09_programs_initiatives.csv]

rows.statement: No lakehouse platform runs a production workload today; the cloud lakehouse is at evaluation stage only, with no pilot and no funded budget line.
rows.why_it_matters: The plan cannot assume a target platform exists. Platform selection, funding and build sit on the critical path ahead of certified datasets.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, data and analytics platform maturity: Databricks Lakehouse (Evaluation Stage), evidence [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/19_data_analytics_platform_maturity.csv]

confirm.answer: Confirmed against the platform maturity assessment dated 2026-07-31: evaluation stage only, with a vendor demo and a one-page brief, no production workload and no signed contract. Synthetic and single-source; not client-attested.
confirm.answer_source: Synthetic platform maturity assessment, Databricks Lakehouse (Evaluation Stage) row, assessed 2026-07-31 [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/19_data_analytics_platform_maturity.csv]

rows.statement: The first semantic-layer release certifies five measures: 30-day readmission rate, open preventive care gaps, member attribution to primary care, provider panel size and ED visits per 1,000.
rows.why_it_matters: The first release scope drives the build estimate and the earliest point at which a report or model can read a certified measure.
rows.source: Synthetic discovery evidence, semantic layer and certified measure definitions [scripts/moves/fixtures/gdf-discovery-aca-smoke/02_p2_discover/02_semantic_layer_certification.md]

rows.statement: Twelve data governance stewards are in post and can staff stewardship for the certified domains without new hires.
rows.why_it_matters: Stewardship capacity limits how many domains can be certified in parallel. If it is wrong, the plan needs hiring or a slower release sequence.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, workforce roles: Data Governance Steward, role_count [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/03_workforce_roles.csv]

confirm.answer: Confirmed against the workforce roles extract: 12 Data Governance Steward roles in the data analytics and AI function. Whether all 12 can be released to this Move is still a planning question. Synthetic; not client-attested.
confirm.answer_source: Synthetic workforce roles extract, Data Governance Steward row [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/03_workforce_roles.csv]

rows.statement: Data governance maturity rises from level 2 (Emerging) to level 3 (Defined) on the 1-5 rubric by the end of the program.
rows.why_it_matters: It is the adoption measure for the governance operating model itself: named owners, ratified definitions and a working council, not just a platform.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, data and analytics platform maturity: Data Governance Program, current_level and target_level [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/19_data_analytics_platform_maturity.csv]

rows.statement: All 53 BI report writers build new reports on certified measures within 12 months of the first certified release.
rows.why_it_matters: Certified measures only create value when the people who build reports use them. The head count is from intake; the adoption rate is a planning assumption.
rows.source: Synthetic tenant intake, workforce roles: BI Analyst / Report Writer, role_count; the adoption rate is a demo planning assumption [datasets/tenant-inputs/active/meridian-health/current/03_workforce_roles.csv]

rows.statement: Half of the ungoverned workbooks (about 310) are retired or rebuilt on certified measures within 12 months of the first certified release.
rows.why_it_matters: Retiring ungoverned workbooks is how the Move shows that certified numbers have replaced uncertified ones, rather than adding another layer beside them.
